title: a16z Podcast: Welcome to the New Era of Commerce

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Just as "social networking" is a bland term that doesn't really capture the layers of what happens underneath (and on top of) social networking platforms..
reader_summary.overview: Just as "social networking" is a bland term that doesn't really capture the layers of what happens underneath (and on top of) social networking platforms. Or so argue the guests on this episode of the a16z Podcast. Crowdfunding isn't just about reaching a certain threshold to make something, but it's also about "pre-commerce" or "pretail" -- the next evolution in commerce.
